note: The Airpark/North campground at 3120 Hwy 213, beside the Reelfoot Lake Airport on the lake's east side; separate from the South Campground on Hwy 21. Two small gravel loops, bathhouse (heated) and dump station near the entrance. Laundry and the camp store are at the South Campground. --Claude
summary: Airpark/North confirmed: 14 RV sites (30A + water, no sewer, 48-66 ft, one pull-through) + 10 tent-only; $32-34 unchanged. Laundry is South's, not here (cleared). Lakefront is not supported: the loops sit west of Phillippy Rd, pool-level swamp forest starts 65-100 m east, open water ~170 m; recommend not waterfront. Pin ~425 m off (in the lake).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> not waterfront recommended (not changed; value is not --AWH): the old evidence rests on coord_fix 36.4708,-89.3435, which is in the flooded cypress past the Airpark parking lot and old inn pier, ~425 m south of the campground. The sites are on two loops west of Phillippy Road (Hwy 213) at ~36.4741,-89.3439 (sites 1-7) and ~36.4751,-89.3438 (sites 8-14). 3DEP: pads 87.1-87.7 m; pool-level ground (86.1-86.2 m) begins ~65-100 m east of the south loop's east side (sites 1-2) across the road, under continuous swamp-forest canopy, and ~240 m east of the north loop (site 8). Nearest open water on OSM ~170 m. Nothing within ~50 m over open ground; no visible lake from the pads on imagery. Most generous reading would be lakeview for sites 1-2 through the swamp forest; defaults-down gives not waterfront. Replacement evidence: 'reserve.tnstateparks.com map + OSM 2026-11-25: Airpark loops 36.4741/36.4751,-89.3438 west of Phillippy Rd; 3DEP pads 87.1-87.7 m, pool-level swamp forest 65-100 m east under continuous canopy, open water ~170 m -> not waterfront'.
PIN MOVE (~425 m): stored 36.4708,-89.3435 (in the lake swamp) -> loop centroid ~36.4746,-89.3438. Google's point 36.47259,-89.34402 is the Airpark parking lot ~220 m south of the loops.

FACILITIES: laundry true -> cleared (null). The park page places the 'washer, dryer, and dishwashing area' in a South Campground bathhouse; the Airpark list names only fire rings, water, a dump station and a heated bathhouse with hot showers.

SITES: count 24 = 14 RV + 10 primitive tent-only (agency wording); the primitive sites are not on the online calendar. Old note's '35-66 ft (sources conflict)' resolved: per-site drive lengths 48-66 ft; old inclusion_evidence 'up to 35 ft' is stale.
FEES unchanged: the calendar for 2026-11-26..12-10 shows $32 weeknights and $34 Fri-Sat on all 14 sites, the stored $32-34.
SEASON: not stated on either page; the calendar sells nights through December, so it is not closed for winter. Left absent.
STATE PARK: booking/fees inherit state:TN; no boilerplate written. Policy 'Most campsites require a minimum of a 2-night stay' not contradicted (no minimum shown on the calendar).
Phone 731-253-9652 (reserve page's after-hours/ranger line) and websites unchanged; tnstateparks.com/parks/campground/reelfoot-lake now redirects to /parks/reelfoot-lake/camping (it works as is).
Park notices (not Airpark): Blue Bank day-use renovation to Feb 2027, Eagle Basin day-use closed from 2026-06-12, Long Park partial closure from 2026-10-19 (~12 weeks).
